g.text: 433 archived internal peel ratios. Dashed line: equal-face wall at 3 + 2√2.
Open circles exceed the wall. Shading propagates the two quoted energy uncertainties. The diamond marks francium's straddling interval.
Lines connect adjacent available atomic numbers; each panel ends with its last available threshold pair. Jeromie Beasley’s VOTKP element atlas.
